usage: Use CommentComposer to enhance your user interface. This component provides a consistent, accessible, and well-designed solution for this use case.
CommentComposer integrates seamlessly with other components in the design system. Follow the established patterns and guidelines to ensure consistency across your application.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled HTML value of the editor. Pair with onChange.

props.name: submitLabel
props.description: Label shown on the submit button. Defaults to "Comment".

props.name: toolbarActions
props.description: Restrict the toolbar to this subset (in this order). Defaults to all actions.

props.name: isSubmitting
props.description: When true, the submit button shows the loading state and is disabled.

bestPractices.title: Use semantic props
bestPractices.description: Use the component's built-in props rather than className overrides.

bestPractices.title: Don't override core styles
bestPractices.description: Avoid using className to override the component's fundamental styling.

bestPractices.title: Provide accessible labels
bestPractices.description: Include proper ARIA labels for screen reader users.

bestPractices.title: Don't skip accessibility
bestPractices.description: Never omit accessibility attributes for interactive components.

bestPractices.title: Handle all states

bestPractices.title: Don't ignore edge cases
